create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a bulk crystal structure
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting a specific index from the bulk database pickle file
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by selecting a bulk structure using its source ID like mp-30
create_bulk_random: create a Bulk object by randomly sampling a bulk structure from the bulk database
get_slabs_from_bulk: get a list of possible slabs for a bulk instance with optional max Miller index and precomputed caching
